name: No Parent Should Bury Their Child takes Abellon's Keepsake on turn-in (#10729)
contract: Quest 175041 (Bury Abellon's keepsake next to the grave of Noghan Dolmen) gives Abellon's Keepsake 559876 as its
start item when accepted. Player::RewardQuest removes a quest's source items (ItemDrop) on reward; the keepsake
is buried, so it must leave the bags. Expected: one keepsake while the quest is in progress, none after the
reward, and the quest's reward item 559976 is delivered.

steps.label: SETUP: the keepsake is handed out with the quest
DISCRIMINATING: the buried keepsake left the bags
